stories.headline: ‘It: Welcome To Derry’ Renewed For Season 2 By HBO; Brad Caleb Kane Now Sole Showrunner - Deadline
stories.summary: 'It: Welcome to Derry' has secured a Season 2 renewal at HBO, Deadline has learned. Brad Caleb Kane takes over as sole showrunner this time.
stories.why: Stephen King adaptations are cycling through prestige TV, and a solo showrunner shift signals HBO is doubling down on horror as premium drama—this matters if you've noticed King properties suddenly feel like 'real' TV instead of genre fodder.

stories.headline: NBC, ABC & CBS Evening News Ratings Shocker for David Muir - Yahoo
stories.why: David Muir losing evening news ground reflects the collapse of broadcast TV authority; if you still trust network anchors, this is your wake-up that generational news gatekeeping is officially over.

stories.headline: Amy Schumer to Star in and Produce Break-Up Comedy ‘Best Divorce Ever’ (EXCLUSIVE) - variety.com
stories.summary: Best Divorce Ever comes from writer/director Sean Mullin, with Concourse Media launching worldwide sales in Toronto
stories.why: Amy Schumer pivoting to divorce comedy signals that post-breakup content is now A-list IP—this matters if you're noticing every comedian now mines personal relationship failure as their prestige move.

stories.headline: Marvel’s Pre-‘Avengers Doomsday’ MCU Watch List May Reveal Secrets - Forbes
stories.summary: Marvel has published a list of MCU movies you should watch before 'Avengers: Doomsday,' and some feature characters not in the film, yet.
stories.why: Marvel's pre-movie watch lists including characters not appearing suggests the MCU is becoming so convoluted that even the studio admits you need homework, signaling the franchise has lost casual accessibility.

stories.headline: Williams-Brice hosting major concert during football season. Here are the details - The State
stories.summary: The South Carolina Gamecocks football team’s Williams-Brice Stadium will host a concert featuring Chris Brown and Usher. What are the dates?
stories.why: A college football stadium hosting major rap acts during season reflects how Gen Z athletes live in a blended sports-entertainment world—this matters if you're seeing recruiting and hype function differently than when you were their age.

stories.headline: ‘Duck Dynasty’ stars Jep and Jessica Robertson say ‘a lot of prayer’ led them to leave Louisiana for Texas - Fox News
stories.summary: Jep and Jessica Robertson reveal the prayer and faith behind their move from Louisiana to North Texas, where they're building Comanche Moon Ranch.
stories.why: Duck Dynasty's pivot from Louisiana to Texas ranch life rebrands them from TV personalities to lifestyle influencers, signaling older reality-TV stars are abandoning their origin story for Instagram authenticity.

stories.headline: ‘It’s Always Sunny’ Season 18 Is for the Sickos - IndieWire
stories.summary: Even in a series known for eliciting consistent disgust, the latest season of Glenn Howerton, Rob Mac, and Charlie Day's series is one for the books.
stories.why: It's Always Sunny doubling down on transgressive humor in its 18th season shows prestige networks now compete by being *more* unhinged, not less—this matters if you've noticed comedy's shock value keeps escalating to stay relevant.
